notes.title: Land of the Crescent And Future Updates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710670/61b286be782fde40a93188b325d600b7d1a1fb49.png

We're thrilled to announce that Ominous is part of the Land of the Crescent event, celebrating games made in Türkiye! As we prepare for the next phase, we're excited to share the details of the upcoming v0.2 update, which focuses on enhancing gameplay, fixing key issues, and adding fresh features for an even more immersive experience.

Here’s a summary of the new additions coming to Ominous in V0.2 Update:

New Features & Additions

 Unique Item Drop on Creature Death: Defeated creatures now drop unique items.

 Increased Friend Interaction Across Dimensions: New ways to connect and interact with friends in other dimensions.

 Creature Capture Room: A jail-like capture room where you can capture creatures.

 Examine The Creatures: Captured creatures can be taken back to your lobby. Examine them to find items for crafting or discover special crafting ingredients.


New Rift Mini-Games

 Memory Match

 Quick Math

 Cup and Ball

 Whack-a-Mole



New Final Room Mini-Games


 Rotating Bridge Puzzle

 Obstacle-Controlled Platform Puzzle

 Guided Maze

 Wind Tunnel Challenge



We’re addressing the following issues in the upcoming update:


 Character Falling Through Map: Players fall through the map upon spawning and can't move when respawned.

 Platform Stuck in Final Room Parkour: Resolving platform movement issues.

 Player Stuck in Respawn Tube: Fixing respawn tube bugs in the final room.

 Character Skin Reset: Preventing outfit resets after teleporting to new areas.

 Treasure Room Item Spawn: Ensuring items spawn correctly and players aren’t locked inside if someone dies.

 Quest Item Visibility: Improving visibility for main loot items.

 Lobby Chair Movement Bug: Limiting unintended chair movement in the lobby.

 Storage Cabinet Overflow: Fixing item overflow between cabinets.

 Treasure Room for Single Players: Ensuring the treasure room only spawns when multiple players are present.

 Lobby Money Sync: Ensuring money syncs correctly in the main lobby.


Thank you for your patience as we work on these improvements!

notes.title: Ominous Update 0.112 Is Now Live
notes.content:
Game Start Crash Fix: Resolved a crash that occurred when forcing the game to start.

notes.title: Ominous 0.111 Hotfix

notes.title: Ominous Update 0.111 Is Now Live
notes.content:
Boss Portal Rift Adjustment:
We've moved the portal rift spawn slightly forward to prevent it from getting stuck.

Custom Unreal Engine Build:
Hi everyone,
To better diagnose and resolve issues in the game, we've created a custom version of Unreal Engine by editing it from the source code. This will allow us to identify and fix problems more effectively.

EULA Update:
We've added the following section to the EULA regarding crash reports:

"Crash Reports and Data Collection
To assist in diagnosing and resolving issues, Ominous collects crash reports that may include details about your PC hardware components, system information, and other relevant data. This information is used solely to improve the stability and performance of the game and to address issues that may cause crashes. By using Ominous, you consent to this data collection and agree that it may be shared with Jumpy Unit, Epic, and their affiliates solely for these purposes."

notes.title: Ominous Update 0.110 Is Now Live
notes.content:
Charge Machine Update: Added more informative UI elements and fixed collision issues with the Charge Machine.

Mini-Game Info UI: Added info UIs to better explain how the Duck Game and Arcade Game mini-games work.

Item Outline Update: Item outlines are now thicker and red for better visibility.

Apply Button Bug: Fixed an issue where clicking the Apply button two or more times in a row prevented the Yes or No buttons from being pressed in the confirmation window.

FUIRS Room Item Bug: Resolved an issue where a battery dropped near the console in the FUIRS room couldn’t be picked up, forcing players to abandon it to proceed.

Sound Overhaul - Part 1: We've introduced the first part of our sound overhaul, adding ambient sounds to the game. These sounds will play at intervals, enhancing the atmosphere.

Crash Report: Added a crash report system. If your game crashes, you can now press "Send" on the pop-up screen to provide detailed information about the crash, helping us resolve issues more quickly.

General Bug Fixes and Optimizations: Various bug fixes and performance improvements have been made across the game.

We've launched a new Discord server to better communicate with our players and gather feedback to improve the game. You can join us here: Discord Server

notes.title: Ominous Update 0.109 Is Now Live
notes.content:
New Discord Server
Hello everyone,
We've launched a new Discord server to better communicate with our players and gather feedback to improve the game. You can join us here: Discord Server

Patch Notes

Energy Canister Collision: Fixed issues with the energy canister collision.

Typewriter Interaction Fix: While using the typewriter, the item radar will no longer appear in your hand, and the emote menu will not open, preventing potential bugs.

Beer Drinking Bug Fix: Resolved a bug where switching to another item while drinking beer would cause the character to keep drinking indefinitely.

Locked Door Update: A new button has been added behind the locked door. After entering the code, you can now press this button to open and close the door, providing a better way to protect yourself from creatures.

Character Movement Improvements:


 Faster acceleration while moving.
 Reworked the velocity effects from platforms, especially in the platform mini-game.
 Improved mid-air control, allowing for better character control while airborne.

Parkour Mini-Game Update: In the parkour mini-game, platforms will no longer revert to their previous state after pressing a button once, as this made the mini-game significantly more difficult.

Inventory Update: Added a section in the lower-left corner that displays the function of the selected item from the inventory.

Mission Button Crash Fix: We believe we've fixed a crash that sometimes occurred when pressing the mission button.

notes.title: Ominous Update 0.108 Is Now Live
notes.content:
AMD Cards Fix: We believe we've resolved the issue with AMD graphics cards. If you're still experiencing problems, please don't hesitate to report the bug to us.

Typewriter Paper Limit: The typewriter paper now stays within its limit.

Remaining Days Counter Fix: Fixed a bug where the remaining days counter would sometimes display incorrectly and cause save corruption.

Initial Load Fix: Resolved the falling down issue that occurred during the initial loading screen.

Block Puzzle Improvement: When you press the correct spot in the Block Puzzle, the area now turns green. If you fall, it's now easier to find your way back.

General Bug Fixes and Performance Improvements: Various bug fixes and enhancements to performance have been made across the game.

notes.title: Ominous Update 0.107 Is Now Live
notes.content:
Menu Issue: Fixed the issue where opening the menu, navigating to any option, and returning to the game would prevent the menu from opening again.

Keybinding Language Bug: Resolved the issue where changing the language of the game caused some keybindings not to function correctly, particularly in languages other than English. 

Keybinding Save Fix: Keybindings now save correctly across sessions.

Arrow Keybinding Issue: Fixed the issue where keybinding to arrow keys wasn't applied due to them being hardbound to movement.

Emote Keybind Fix: The emote keybind is now functional and clickable.

Item Radar Keybinding: Added keybinding functionality for the Item Radar.

Emote Menu Improvement: You can now open the emote menu without being forced to use an emote to close it. Releasing B now cancels the menu correctly when pressed with mouse left-click animation will play.

Parkour Mini-Game: The parkour mini-game has been made easier.

Private Lobby Visibility: Improved the visibility of private lobbies in the join game menu. If a session is set to "friends only," it will now be visible in the UI if you are friends with the server owner.

Vendor Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where the vendor sometimes didn’t give money after selling an item.

Tutorial Adjustments: Minor adjustments have been made to the tutorial.

General Optimization and Bug Fixes: Various optimizations and bug fixes have been implemented across the game.

Coming Soon


Sound Overhaul: We are currently working on a complete overhaul of the game’s sounds, which will be updated soon.

notes.title: Ominous Update 0.106 Is Now Live
notes.content:
Outline Shader: Added an outline shader for objects.

Tutorial Fatal Error Fix: Resolved the fatal error occurring in the bar section at the end of the tutorial.

Upgrade and Crafting Improvements: Enhancements have been made to the upgrade and crafting systems.

Creature Behavior: Creatures will now behave more stably.

Code Optimization and Bug Fixes: Various optimizations and bug fixes have been implemented across the codebase.

notes.title: Ominous Update 0.105 Is Now Live
notes.content:
Crash Fix: Resolved the issue where the game would crash if someone sat in a chair after pressing the red button.

Lobby UI Fix: Fixed the info UI that appeared when sitting in a chair in the lobby.

Bar Warning: Added a warning message in the bar to notify players when there's not enough space left.

Upgrade System Fixes:
Resolved the bug that occurred when pressing the upgrade button.
General fixes and improvements to the upgrade system.

Keybinding Feature: You can now set keybindings in the control section.

Tutorial Text Fixes: Various fixes to the text in the tutorial.

Gameplay Adjustment: Game durations have been extended by 30%, and creatures will now spawn later.

General Bug Fixes: Various bugs and issues have been addressed across the game.

notes.title: Ominous Update 0.104 Is Now Live
notes.content:
Voice Chat Volume Adjustment: The voice chat volume has been reduced.

Item Spawn Fix: Energy canisters and portal batteries will no longer spawn in areas where they could get stuck.

Keypad Bug Fix: Resolved the bug that occurred when pressing the Enter key on the keypad.

Spectate Camera Update: The spectate camera now correctly follows the player's view when they move.

Mail Room Interaction Fix: After placing an item in the mail room and closing the gate, you can no longer interact with the item.

Tutorial Improvements:

-Robot and elevator speeds have been slowed down to prevent bugs.
-Fixed the issue where players could get stuck after interacting with the menu.

General Fixes: Various bug fixes and improvements have been implemented across the game.
